title: Checks on evidence responses before they are sent
scope: Move the TAX-044/048 checks and TAX-078 reminders onto the evidence-response page so wrong periods, unreadable files and amounts that do not match the requested item are flagged before sending

acceptance.text: Before sending, each answered item shows guidance from the reconciliation and Docling extraction (period, legibility, amount against the requested line); guidance never blocks sending
Relevant earlier-claim reminders appear on the response page; failure to load them never blocks the response
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Unit and browser tests for each check and the non-blocking behaviour

evidence.text: Observed 2026-11-12: vati_tax/responses/checks.py (pure) gives per-document guidance from the latest Docling extraction on each answered item: legibility (not readable, partly read, still being read), period (dates vs the requested invoice's month or the claim's VAT period), and for TAX-127 line items the VAT amount and invoice number against the requested line; fixed neutral wording, only found dates/amounts quoted back. portal.api.review_evidence_response stores nothing, has the same scope as sending and returns blocks_sending false; respond_to_evidence_request never runs it (test_checks NonBlockingTests). Unread documents are queued once for a Docling read as the pipeline service (pipeline.store.request_draft_extraction / extract_draft, deduplicated per document); the case pipeline reuses that revision after sending. Portal 'Before you send' region on Review and send with per-item guidance, Change item N, Check again; checks unavailable never block sending. Tests: test_checks.py 15 OK; response-checks.spec.ts 18/18 at 1440/1024/390 with axe and overflow; 3 new bench tests in test_responses_bench.py written but NOT run (no Docker/Frappe site in this session).

Observed 2026-11-12: TAX-078 reminders relevant to the requested document types (and any reminder the server marked on a check) appear on the response page in a closed-by-default disclosure; checks covered by a reminder say 'Also noted on an earlier claim'. Reminders failing to load show 'You can still answer and send this request' and the response sends (response-checks.spec 'reminders that cannot load never block the response'); first-time claimants see no panel. responseChecks.test.ts 6 OK.

Observed 2026-11-12: evidence and 18 screenshots in docs/evidence/TAX-126; npm run check passed (one pre-existing eslint warning in apps/shared/components/SideDrawer.vue); dev.py check passed; ruff check and mypy passed; Playwright responses/inbox/reminders/claim specs 78 passed and taxpayer spec passed with the change. Bench tests not run (no Frappe site available).
